item.title: Using a UPS is game changing for console standby usage, or why next-gen consoles should require BBU...
item.author: invalid@example.com (LGHT_TRSN)
item.dc:creator: LGHT_TRSN
item.content:encoded: Uninterruptible power is necessary to maintain a consistent session state. Until I started using a UPS, console standby was always really flakey. Since adding the UPS I have literally never had a problem. Batteries are cheap these days so I say we demand all new consoles contain a battery backup to maintain session state during standby. Thank you for your time.
